profile.headline: Experienced software developer, leader, mentor and agile-advocate!
profile.summary:
Senior Software developer. Passionate about Agile and Team Mentoring.

I've provided technical and team leadership and am a big picture thinker. I have proficiency in Full-stack Microsoft .Net development with Continuous Integration and Azure, with a passion for web development and Agile methodologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Most proud of developing a side-by-side solution for running our app in the newest technologies, for the technical challenges we overcame and providing an integrated end-user experience. 
-Developed new features for our cloud-platform SaaS company in the latest .Net core C# and Angular technologies
-Mentored, On-boarded and connected with and learned from our top-notch developers
-Passionately sought to improve our Agile methodology iterative approach 
-Worked on the toughest performance issues to develop solutions to enhance performance of our app. 
-Created comprehensive documentation for on-boarding, as well as our application with helpful knowledge-sharing.

positions.title: Application Architect
positions.description:
Acted as Scrum master and led Scrum master guild meetings to align several teams.
Contributed to development of Java/Spring core web product with hundreds of clients and customizations.
Created and maintained wiki for company and team for knowledge sharing.
Implemented and supported moving to the use of Jira Cloud for our issue tracking system to support Agile.
Learned fundamentals of Git as our team moved to GitLab from Subversion.
Worked to troubleshoot customer installations with code or performance issues.
Wrote JUnit tests and refactored code to make more testable.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked to re-brand core product web application after company acquisition.
Helped introduce team to Agile methodologies.
Acted as Scrum master and led Scrum master guild meetings to align several teams.
Served on team to help move Agile forward at the company.
Continued programming and day to day operations to enhance product.
Increased my knowledge of Docker to a beginner level.
Learned AWS to move internal servers to the cloud.

positions.title: Application Architect
positions.description:
Worked on core product web application using Java, JSP/JSTL and Servlets with hundreds of clients and customizations.
Contributed to redesign of core product web application to move portions of the app to Java and Spring framework.
Created best practices with team and documented for knowledge sharing.
Helped to automate installation of the core product.
Wrote JUnit tests and refactored code to make more testable.
Introduced Continuous Integration Server to enhance code quality.

positions.title: Senior Developer/Tech Lead Consultant
positions.description:
Contracted to help with Agile methodology training and Requirements Gathering sessions.
Developed a WPF windows Drag and Drop application, using XAML and C#.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked on redbox.com, an ASP.Net MVC Web application in Agile team setting.
Helped integrate CQ5 Content Management System (in Java) with .Net backend services.
Learned jQuery to modify existing complex javascript libraries.

positions.title: Senior Developer/Tech Lead Consultant
positions.description:
Learned client’s project architecture quickly to make an immediate design and development contribution while working with on-site project team.
Stepped into tech lead role to help manage technical dependencies and coordinate other with other teams for code completion and deployment.
Developed parts of an insurance fulfillment application for the client using Java/Hibernate/Spring technologies, including front-end web application with JSP and Javascript.
Worked on improving survey engine Java software that was distributed to thousands of laptops.
Helped to improve the build processes and streamline business processes for client in the trading industry, using several open source technologies, including Ant, SVN Kit, Ivy and Bamboo.

positions.title: Senior Developer/Tech Lead Consultant
positions.description:
Contributed to agile methods, including stand ups, pair programming and automated testing.
Technically managed team of 6-9 through iterative development cycles, including story writing, estimation, iteration planning, requirements gathering, design and test-driven development.
Quickly learned existing architecture and new technologies to contribute to the project.
Developed with Java and Open Source technologies: Hibernate, Spring, Struts, JUnit, JMock.
Delivered three phases of major online project in a retail environment with internationalization support in 7 months with the company.

positions.title: Architect/Senior Developer/Technical Lead
positions.description:
Led redesign of several existing components resulting in improved automated process flow.
Architected overall solution for new client project within first month of joining the company that was used daily for years.
Used MS technologies, including .NET 2.0 in C#, VB.NET, Sql Server 2005, Reporting Services.
Developed a complex automated back-end solution to run on a scheduler, reporting website, integrated with Reporting Services and generated client reports with Reporting Services.
Led project using Agile Methodologies to do project planning, tracking and estimation in an iterative development cycle.
Integrated NUnit for automated testing on the most complex part of the system to ensure good quality and Log4Net to automate sending error emails and system logging.

positions.title: Architect/Technical Lead/Software Developer
positions.description:
Led a team of six people through several project iterations, including design, developer support and task assignment.
Used Agile process methodologies, including task-level project planning and automated testing; our team was successful at keeping our projects on time and within budget.
Helped to define standards and best practices for team and initiated meetings for team buy-in.
Developed a large-scale web application using Java and Open Source technologies with SOA.
Ramped up quickly on Tapestry and Hibernate, resulting in an immediate team contribution.
Coached other developers in Tapestry, TomCat, Eclipse, Java and .NET 2005, ASP.NET.
Began several initiatives, including Lunch and Learn Meetings, which covered technical and company culture related topics.
Gained experience with public speaking through Toastmasters and company meetings.
Worked on client project on the .NET 2005 platform, using Master Pages, and coding in C#.

positions.title: Architect Team Developer
positions.description:
Project Development Role
Worked on Visual Studio .NET project in C# WebForms for equity and fixed income security information.
Interacted with a global team headquartered in NY, London, and Tokyo for design and development of front-end screen development of project.

Architecture Role
Developed architecture for ASP/VB/MTS intranet applications with SQL Server and Oracle databases.
Implemented web architecture on several projects used by internal sales and other groups.
Consulted on troubleshooting issues for all MS applications supporting 30+ developers.
Worked with architecture team to develop several reusable components, such as data access and error logging.

Training Role
Developed and taught curriculum for developers on ASP/VB/MTS/Scripting technologies.
Mentored several co-workers individually to improve skills in web development.
Created detailed documentation website for architecture diagrams, installs and coding standards.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Led business object middleware team of five people in defect resolution stage of project.
Designed and implemented business object middleware layer of a Microsoft n-tier system using Visual Basic 6.0 and  helped team members debug complex MTS-related defects.
Acquired experience implementing a large-scale logistics application using VB 6.0, DHTML, HTML, Active Server Pages, JavaScript, VBScript, ADO and an Oracle database.
